profile_text.body:
Credo AI, founded in 2020, describes itself as the trusted leader in AI governance. The company created the AI governance category and operates a platform designed to help enterprises discover their AI systems, enforce policies, prove compliance, and manage risk across models, agents, and applications. Its core offering, the Credo AI platform, combines a Knowledge Graph of global regulatory intelligence with business context to enable what the company calls "Measurable Trust." The platform includes policy packs with regulatory intelligence for the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and other standards, along with native integrations across existing enterprise stacks.

The platform extends governance across pilots and production deployments with agent-level, application-level, and model-level controls. Credo AI states it built the platform "from scratch" for AI governance rather than adding AI features to existing GRC tools. The company highlights GAIA (Govern AI Assistant), described as generally available in the platform, which compresses weeks of governance work into hours by turning policy into code through automated workflows and audit-ready evidence generation.

The company's customer base spans insurance, financial services, federal, and healthcare sectors, with testimonials from Mastercard, IBM, and others referencing accelerated compliance workflows and enterprise-scale AI risk management.
